description: AMP-Embarque de combustible según litoral 2018 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Maritima de Panamá. Presenta movimiento de embarque de ventas totales de combustible según litoral en barriles netos. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Maritima de Panamá. Its tags are Combustible, Estadísticas de Gobierno, Maritimo, ventas. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2020-09-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
